items.title: Entire 'Primary Care' section (well-child care) absent from toc_inventory.json
items.summary: research/tn2025/unresolved_headings.json flags 'PrimaryCaré' as one of P's two UNRESOLVED headings (source_pdf_page 1197, TOC page-number OCR did not parse to a trusted anchor). toc_inventory.json has no node at all for this section or its subtopics. Independently resolved via raw OCR of the chapter's own TOC page (pdf 1197) and body pages 1200-1206 (P4-P10): the section runs from immediately after 'Pediatric Quick Reference Values' (P.S01, P3) to immediately before 'Common Complaints' (P.S02, P10), covering Visit Overview, Routine Immunization, Growth and Development, Nutrition, a sixth body heading not named in the TOC line itself ('Injury Prevention Counselling'), and Circumcision.
items.resolution_status: INDEPENDENTLY RESOLVED (not left open) - represented as SU-P-002 through SU-P-007 under synthetic UNCATALOGUED:PrimaryCare@pdf1200.T01-T06 ids since no toc_inventory.json node exists to cite.
items.recommended_action: Coordinator should consider adding corresponding nodes to toc_inventory.json for chapter P (between P.S01 and P.S02, pdf pages 1200-1206) in a future TOC-extraction pass, since this is a substantial six-subtopic clinical section entirely missing from the pipeline's output (dropped, not merged) - the same class of gap seen in chapter A's SU-A-07 case. Not low-priority: unlike A's single-topic gap, this recovered section carries high-yield, directly-DIRECT-mapped MCC content (well-child visit, immunization, growth/development, nutrition).

items.title: P.S05.T02/T03 ('Acyanotic'/'Cyanotic Congenital Heart Disease') are multi-disease umbrella nodes
items.summary: toc_inventory.json captures 'Acyanotic Congenital Heart Disease' and 'Cyanotic Congenital Heart Disease' as single T-level nodes each, but raw OCR of pdf 1217-1220 (P21-P24) body-confirms each groups multiple independently-testable named lesions with their own definition/epidemiology/investigations/management subsections (Acyanotic: VSD, ASD, PDA, coarctation, aortic stenosis, pulmonary stenosis; Cyanotic: TOF, TGA, TAPVR, truncus arteriosus, HLHS, Ebstein's anomaly).
items.resolution_status: INDEPENDENTLY RESOLVED - split into 11 recovered per-lesion study units (SU-P-026 through SU-P-036) under synthetic UNCATALOGUED:CHD@pdf... ids; P.S05.T02/T03 retained only as organizational-header references (added to organizational_header_nodes) since their content is fully redistributed.
items.recommended_action: None required for chapter P's own crosswalk (fully resolved and validated). Coordinator may wish to note this splitting precedent for any future chapter with a similarly-titled umbrella CHD heading.

items.title: P.S15.T04 ('Neurocutaneous Syndromes') groups two distinct named syndromes
items.summary: Raw OCR of pdf 1285 (P89) body-confirms this single toc_inventory.json node contains two genuinely distinct, independently-testable diagnoses (Neurofibromatosis Type 1 and Type 2), each with its own diagnostic-criteria subsection. No Tuberous Sclerosis/Sturge-Weber subsection is present in this TN edition's text.
items.resolution_status: INDEPENDENTLY RESOLVED - split into SU-P-138 (NF1) and SU-P-139 (NF2) under synthetic UNCATALOGUED:Neurocutaneous@pdf1285.NF1/NF2 ids; P.S15.T04 retained only as an organizational-header reference.
items.recommended_action: None required; fully resolved and validated.

items.title: P.S15.T06 ('Seizure Disorders') groups a general approach plus four named childhood epilepsy syndromes
items.summary: Raw OCR of pdf 1286 (P90) body-confirms this single toc_inventory.json node contains a general seizure-management/investigation/seizure-mimics approach together with four distinct, independently-testable named epilepsy syndromes (Infantile Spasms/West syndrome, Lennox-Gastaut, Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy, Childhood Absence Epilepsy), before cross-referencing the adult Neurology chapter (N19) for generalized/partial seizures.
items.resolution_status: INDEPENDENTLY RESOLVED - split into SU-P-141 (general approach, retained under the original P.S15.T06 node id) plus four recovered syndrome-specific units (SU-P-142 through SU-P-145) under synthetic UNCATALOGUED:Seizures@pdf1286.* ids.
items.recommended_action: None required; fully resolved and validated.

items.title: P.S13.T04 ('Common Conditions of Neonates') is a nested organizational sub-header, not a study unit
items.summary: Raw OCR of pdf ~1266 body-confirms this node's title introduces the group of already-separately-catalogued specific-condition subsections (T05-T17: Apnea, Bleeding Disorders in Neonates, BPD, Cyanosis, Diaphragmatic Hernia, Hypoglycemia, Neonatal Hyperbilirubinemia, NEC, PPHN, Respiratory Distress, ROP, Sepsis, Skin Conditions) and has no independent content of its own.
items.resolution_status: INDEPENDENTLY RESOLVED - excluded as organizational (added to organizational_header_nodes) rather than represented as its own study unit.
items.recommended_action: None required; fully resolved and validated.

items.title: 'Acromyms' UNRESOLVED heading confirmed as chapter-opening acronym glossary
items.summary: research/tn2025/unresolved_headings.json's other P entry ('Acromyms', source_pdf_page 1197) is confirmed via the same raw-OCR TOC-page read used to recover 'Primary Care' to be the chapter-opening acronym glossary immediately preceding P.S01 (Pediatric Quick Reference Values).
items.resolution_status: INDEPENDENTLY RESOLVED - excluded as non-clinical, consistent with the chapter-opening acronym-glossary exclusion precedent (OP.S01/OB.S01/NS.S01/OR.S01/OT.S01).
items.recommended_action: None required; low-priority, consistent with an established cross-chapter pattern.

items.title: Ebstein's Anomaly
items.summary: mcc_evidence cites objective 36 'Genetic concerns' at WEAK strength (requires_scope_review: true) for the maternal-lithium/benzodiazepine teratogenic-exposure association, which is a secondary rather than primary teaching point for this unit.
items.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether the WEAK 36 citation should be dropped, retaining only the MODERATE objective-19 evidence.

items.title: Pediatric Thyroid Dysfunction (Hyperthyroidism and Hypothyroidism)
items.summary: mcc_evidence cites objective 101 'Stature abnormal' at WEAK strength (requires_scope_review: true) for growth-failure secondary to untreated congenital hypothyroidism, a secondary rather than primary teaching link.
items.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether the WEAK 101 citation adds value or should be dropped in favour of the MODERATE objective-63 evidence alone.

items.title: Disorders of Sexual Development
items.summary: mcc_evidence cites objective 93-1 'Abnormal pubertal development' at WEAK strength (requires_scope_review: true) since this unit's primary content is the newborn-period ambiguous-genitalia presentation rather than pubertal-onset DSD.
items.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm the WEAK 93-1 citation's continued value once a global DSD-vs-pubertal-development ownership decision is made.

items.title: Hereditary Spherocytosis; Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase Deficiency
items.summary: Both units cite objective 49 'Jaundice' at WEAK strength (requires_scope_review: true) for their secondary link to severe neonatal jaundice, which is a real but non-primary teaching point relative to their primary hemolytic-anemia framing (objective 42-1, MODERATE).
items.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether the WEAK 49 citations should be dropped or retained given the genuine (if secondary) neonatal-jaundice link.

items.title: Growing Pains
items.summary: mcc_evidence cites objective 67-1-2-1 'Generalized pain disorders' at WEAK strength (requires_scope_review: true) as a broader chronic-pain objective that only loosely matches growing pains' specific childhood presentation, alongside the STRONG objective-50-3 primary match.
items.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether the WEAK 67-1-2-1 citation should be dropped as redundant given the STRONG 50-3 match already anchors this unit.

items.title: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (Pediatric)
items.summary: mcc_evidence cites objective 38 'Skin and integument conditions' at WEAK strength (requires_scope_review: true) for the malar-rash finding, a secondary rather than primary teaching link relative to the MODERATE objective-50-2 polyarthralgia match.
items.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether the WEAK 38 citation adds value or should be dropped.

items.title: Infective Endocarditis (Pediatric)
items.summary: Final MCC scope adjudication resolved this unit to CROSS_DISCIPLINE because existing Cardiology and Infectious Diseases units already represent infective-endocarditis recognition and prophylaxis under objective 62; this unit retains pediatric risk context.
items.recommended_action: Carry the overlap into ownership review without adding a redundant objective mapping.

items.title: Autism Spectrum Disorder mapping resolved to MCC objective 21
items.summary: Canonical objective 21 explicitly names autism spectrum disorders as causal conditions and directs developmental screening, early intervention, and specialized assessment.

items.title: Acute Leukemia (Pediatric)
items.summary: Final MCC scope adjudication resolved this unit to CROSS_DISCIPLINE because the existing Hematology acute-lymphoblastic-leukemia unit already represents the competency under objective 120; objectives 15-1 and 54 remain presentation-level overlaps rather than direct anchors.
items.recommended_action: Carry the overlap into ownership review without adding a redundant objective mapping.

items.title: Cross-discipline / intra-chapter content overlap recorded but not resolved
items.summary: Per the resume brief's instruction not to finalize PRIMARY_OWNER/CROSS_LINK/DISTINCT_CONTEXT until the global cross-discipline audit, several study units carry a cross_discipline_note flagging overlap either with a completed adult-discipline chapter (Hematology) or between two independently-full TN write-ups within Pediatrics itself (e.g. Cystic Fibrosis appears as a full GI-focused write-up under P.S09.T15 and a full pulmonary-focused write-up under P.S16.T03 - these are not duplicates but genuinely different-content sections in the source, confirmed by raw-OCR page reads of both).
items.recommended_action: Coordinator to resolve primary ownership during the planned global cross-discipline audit; no chapter-P-specific action needed now.
